simple.meaning: to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs, especially the ankle); by implication, to falter , stumble , faint or fall
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כָּשַׁל (H3782) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 65 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: כָּשַׁל (kâshal) means to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs, especially the ankle); by implication, to falter , stumble , faint or fall First listed occurrence: 1Sam 2 4.
